title: Ezra scan split
description: A white band split in two: a pale panel starting at the content column's left edge holds a tiny caps eyebrow, a 45px light serif heading, a body line and two white outline pills; a photo bleeds from the panel to the window's right edge with a small midnight result card pinned to that edge. On phones the text stacks over the photo and the card overlaps the photo's top.
notes: the photo is a media slot filling the right side (a 375px band on phones)
the result card is always dark: it scopes `dark` and reads the theme's .dark colours
name: ezra-scan
